verdict.rationale: Requesty documents a real-time analytics dashboard that tracks costs across all models and providers in one place. The service-accounts doc implies spend is normally attributed to users. However, the evidence never shows spend broken down by API key or by team: per-key spend caps (docs-18) are a limit control, not reporting. Missing for 10: documented per-key and per-team spend breakdowns, explicit per-user cost reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can track spend per model, key, team, or user across all providers in one place

citations.quote: Requesty's analytics dashboard gives you complete visibility into your AI usage across all models and providers. Track costs, requests, tokens, cache savings, and latency, all in real-time.
